title: Dogs in the park
scene: On Sunday Anna's family has a picnic near the pavilion in the park. They meet dogs of every kind - a bulldog, a beagle, a basset, a husky, a collie and a pit bull - see how dogs act by instinct, hear about a parasite from dirty water and clean up a dog's excrement.

words.ex: We had a picnic in the park on Sunday.
We had lunch in the park pavilion.
Our bulldog loves to sleep on the sofa.
Our beagle loves to smell everything on walks.
Our basset has very long ears and short legs.
Our husky has bright blue eyes and thick fur.
Our collie helps the farmer move the sheep.
My neighbor has a friendly pit bull.
Cats catch mice by instinct, not by learning.

Please clean up your dog's excrement in the park.

title: Grandma's farm
scene: Anna and Max help on Grandma's farm. The farmer next door drives a tractor over many hectares, an old mule carries ten bushels of apples from the homestead, bees collect nectar, and Grandma talks about pesticides and a new hybrid tree.

words.ex: I buy eggs from a local farmer.
The farmer drove his tractor across the field.

Bees collect nectar from flowers to make honey.
Farmers spray pesticides on their crops.
This tree is a hybrid of two species.

title: Hiking in the Carpathians
scene: Anna and Max go hiking in the Carpathian Mountains. They camp near a cliff, use a compass to find the peak, feel the breeze from the canyon under old cedars, sit on granite rocks on a high plateau, look at the local flora and paddle a canoe across a lake, where they meet boy scouts who love scouting.

How much does summer camp cost?
The house stands on top of a high cliff.

From the top, we saw a panorama of the city.

title: National parks in America
scene: Max's cousin works as a park ranger in America. He shows them a grizzly, a coyote, a raccoon near the trash, bison, gophers and caribou, wild mustangs and an alligator in the swamp, warns them about cougars and makes a fire from hickory wood.

A cougar was seen near the hiking trail.
We used hickory wood for the barbecue.

title: Under the sea
scene: On a sea voyage Anna watches the water: an orca jumps, a fisherman catches a marlin, mackerel and a carp from a river, a pelican and an albatross fly over the boat, and a diver shows them a coral reef full of plankton and a tiny hydra.

words.ex: The ship's voyage took three weeks.
An orca jumped out of the water.

title: A climate strike
scene: Anna joins a climate strike. Students talk about smog in the city, the ozone layer and melting icebergs, methane, carbon dioxide and fracking, eco solutions, and how a tornado or a tsunami can hit a whole region.

words.ex: The climate here is warm and dry.
Is there a train strike tomorrow?

The ozone layer protects us from the sun.

title: At the natural history museum
scene: Taras's class visits the natural history museum. They see a dinosaur, a dodo, old primates like the gibbon, an artifact and a fragment of an old bone, learn how each organism lives, watch a chameleon, a cocoon and termites that use pheromones, and read about fauna and even cannibalism among animals.

The dodo was a bird that could not fly.

title: A weekend in Paris
scene: Anna and her mama spend a weekend in Paris. A waiter says 'Bonjour, monsieur' to a man, 'madame' to Mama and 'mademoiselle' to Anna; they eat madeleines, creme brulee and brie in a bistro, buy a beret, pay a lot of euros, admire the facade of an old chateau, and drink cognac and pinot noir in a wine bar, dressed a la old movie stars.

words.ex: Good evening, monsieur, welcome to our hotel.
"Madame, your table is ready," said the waiter.

title: Summer in Italy and Spain
scene: Max and his parents go on a cruise on a big liner. In Venice they take a gondola along a canal and drink coffee in a piazza, see an old villa and a palace, and in Spain they walk on the promenade, buy souvenirs, dance at a fiesta, drink chardonnay and meet a compatriot from Kyiv.

title: Rainy days in London
scene: During her summer course in London Anna learns to dress for rain: a trench coat, a poncho, a warm jumper, a fleece and a shawl. She pays in sterling, eats scones and toffee, sees an old painting sold for a hundred guineas, and asks a constable for directions.

title: Interrail to the North
scene: Max travels by train. In Berlin Herr and Frau Weber invite him to a beer fest; in the Alps he wears a cardigan, sleeps in a chalet near an old baron's castle, hears an echo, learns about each Swiss canton and pays in francs; in Norway he pays in krone, sees a fjord and a Viking ship, and in Iceland a geyser and magma under the ground, and almost gets hypothermia.

title: Letters in Athens
scene: In Athens Anna tries to read the signs. She learns the Greek letters - alpha, gamma, kappa, mu, theta, phi, chi, sigma and omega - visits the old citadel on a hill and gets lost in a garden labyrinth.
